source_name: Quantum-resistant signing on AWS, Part 1: Build a software supply chain with ML-DSA
requirement: Make EXTERNAL_MU (externally computed 64-byte mu via OpenSSL 3.5) the pipeline's default KMS ML-DSA signing method for artifacts of any size; use RAW message type only for inputs of fixed, small size.
evidence_quote: Make the EXTERNAL_MU method your pipeline's default: compute the 64-byte message representative (mu) externally with OpenSSL 3.5, then pass only mu to AWS KMS.
evidence_location: Signing artifacts with ML-DSA in your CI/CD pipeline > Binary and package signing

requirement: Protect integrity of signed artifacts and their signatures by enabling S3 Object Lock (WORM), or at minimum S3 Versioning with restricted write access.
evidence_quote: Protect the integrity of both the artifact and its signature by enabling S3 Object Lock (WORM protection) or at minimum S3 Versioning with restricted write access.
